verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented Browserbase setting or session option that blocks images or CSS by default to save bandwidth. The only related item is a generic mention of 'network interception' in browser control. That is a developer building block for constructing request blocking, not the default resource-blocking capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests

citations.quote: Full browser control with auto-waits, network interception, and multi-tab support.
